title: Skyscraper Museum

services.name: Gallery Rental
services.desc: In honor of the 25th anniversary of September 11th, 2001, the Museum's director, Carol Willis, will offer a special tour of the World Trade Center Gallery. Learn about the history of the site before and after 2001 and discover in-depth the models of the Twin Towers and the new One World Trade Center in the Museum’s collection. Curator's tours are FREE! No RSVP is required for this program. Tour space is limited to 20 people, first-come-first-served. The programs of The Skyscraper Museum are supported, in part, by public funds from the New York City Department of Cultural Affairs in partnership with the City Council. blurb: Located in New York City, the world's first and foremost vertical metropolis, The Skyscraper Museum celebrates the City's rich architectural heritage and examines the historical forces and individuals that have shaped its successive skylines.
